_comment: Copy to ats-feeds.json. Employer -> public ATS job-feed registry, consumed by fetch-ats.mjs. Build it with discover-ats.mjs (Greenhouse/Lever/SmartRecruiters/Ashby/Workable) and discover-workday.mjs (Workday). These are the ATSs' own public endpoints: free, no API key, no scraping.
_keywords: Server-side search terms, used ONLY for Workday (which requires a search string) and for SmartRecruiters boards over 400 postings. Replace with your field's core terms. Everything else is pulled in full and filtered locally by triage.mjs.

feeds._note: Greenhouse: slug is the path in job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>.
Lever: slug is the path in jobs.lever.co/<slug>.
SmartRecruiters: slug is case-sensitive. Over 400 postings triggers server-side keyword filtering.
Workday: host/tenant/site come from the careers URL. Get them with discover-workday.mjs. HTTP_422 means the path is wrong; HTTP_500 means the path is right but the tenant is erroring.
Paylocity: both values are visible in the board URL recruiting.paylocity.com/recruiting/jobs/All/<guid>/<companySlug>.
